item.name: Trigger a manual sync for a data source

request.name: Trigger a manual sync for a data source

description.content: Queues a one-off poll of the data source on connector-runner. Bypasses the business-hours gate and per-resource cadence counter. Returns 202 once the request is queued; the poll itself runs asynchronously. Returns 409 if the source is already mid-sync, 503 if connector-runner is unreachable. The 409 is best-effort: the status check and trigger are separate calls, so a scheduled poll can grab the lease between them — clients should treat 409 as a UX hint, not a hard guarantee.
